_metadata.primary_reference: NCHRP Report 1-37A (2004), Guide for Mechanistic-Empirical Design of New and Rehabilitated Pavement Structures
_metadata.issued_by: AASHTO (American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials)
_metadata.current_status: Official AASHTO design method since 2008 (supersedes AASHTO 1993)
_metadata.verification_status: National calibration coefficients VERIFIED against NCHRP 1-37A. Simplifications below documented explicitly.
simplifications_applied: Single equivalent annual temperature (no seasonal climate variation)
Single equivalent axle load BZZ-100 instead of full axle load spectrum
Single equivalent dynamic modulus instead of E*(f, T) master curve
Single-pass evaluation at reference condition (no Miner's law damage accumulation across seasons)
Bottom-up fatigue and total rutting only (NOT implementing: top-down fatigue, thermal cracking, IRI evolution)

standard_axle_load._note_for_iLLM_PD: For cross-spec comparability with JTG D50-2017, our simplified implementation uses BZZ-100 (100 kN) as the equivalent single axle. This introduces a ~25% bias relative to formal ME-PDG ESAL definition; documented as simplification.

where.N_f: Number of repetitions to fatigue cracking initiation
where.ε_t: Tensile strain at the bottom of HMA layer (in/in or m/m)
where.E: Dynamic modulus of HMA layer (psi or MPa)

national_calibration_coefficients._verification: VERIFIED — these are the published NCHRP 1-37A national calibration values, widely cited in literature.
national_calibration_coefficients._unit_convention: When ε_t in microstrain and E in MPa, units must be converted; we use ε_t in microstrain and E in MPa internally, then apply unit-consistency factor.

C_factor._simplification_iLLM_PD: We use C = 1.0 (typical mix) since we don't have V_b (binder content) and V_a (air voids) as inputs.

where.D: damage = sum(n_i / N_fi) by Miner's rule

fatigue_cracking_transfer_function._simplification_iLLM_PD: For our single-pass evaluation, we use a simplified linear approximation: FC% ≈ min(100, (n / N_f) · 100), where n is the design ESAL.

design_criterion._ref: AASHTOWare Pavement ME default reliability terminal value

rutting_model.model_form_per_sublayer: log10(ε_p/ε_r) = β_r1 + β_r2·log10(T_F) + β_r3·log10(N)  [implementation: ε_p/ε_r = 10^β_r1 · T_F^β_r2 · N^β_r3, equivalent log-form of NCHRP 1-37A Eq 3.3.7]

national_calibration_coefficients_HMA._note: k1 in original notation is a separate intercept; for the form here, k1 = 0.

rutting_model._simplification_iLLM_PD: We compute HMA rutting only at a single equivalent temperature. Unbound layer rutting estimated via simpler form.

design_criterion._note: Default for highways; user-adjustable. AASHTOWare default 0.75 inch = 19 mm.

reference_climate._simplification_iLLM_PD: Full ME-PDG uses 20-year hourly climate. We use single equivalent annual temperature.
reference_climate._note: Mean annual temperature (°C). Affects HMA dynamic modulus.

performance_criteria_defaults._ref: AASHTOWare Pavement ME default performance criteria

interstate._note: Strictest criteria for high-volume interstate facilities

secondary._note: Most permissive criteria for local/secondary roads

structural_response_required.ε_t_AC_bottom: Horizontal tensile strain at the bottom of HMA layer (microstrain)
structural_response_required.ε_v_subgrade_top: Vertical compressive strain at the top of subgrade (microstrain)

_iLLM_PD_FEA_fields.ε_t_AC_bottom: epsilon_a_microstrain  (same physical location as JTG ε_a)
_iLLM_PD_FEA_fields.ε_v_subgrade_top: epsilon_z_microstrain  (same physical location as JTG ε_z)

structural_response_required._note: By design, JTG and ME-PDG require the same FEA outputs from our axisymmetric model. Only the transfer functions differ.
